legacy_headroom.requires: denominator definition, baseline/recovery calibration and Owner acceptance

metrics.name: core_ready
metrics.semantic_boundary: process launch to adapter-free deterministic status/command readiness
metrics.derivation: Baseline cold and warm complete-release trials; Owner ceiling before confirmation

metrics.name: first_use
metrics.semantic_boundary: first admitted capability request to ready/useful response, separated from core boot
metrics.derivation: Paired demand/resident lifecycle measurement with fixed semantics

metrics.name: idle_cpu
metrics.semantic_boundary: whole attributed process boundary with entitlement and collector semantics
metrics.derivation: Quiescent baseline and enabled-idle deltas; do not compare unexplained percent counters

metrics.name: wakeups
metrics.semantic_boundary: exact OS collector definition; portable equivalence not established
metrics.derivation: Measured collector sensitivity; unavailable on unsupported profile

metrics.name: memory
metrics.semantic_boundary: current and peak attributed memory; RSS, working set, commit and cgroup charge separate
metrics.derivation: Simultaneous tree measurement plus declared transient/recovery reserves

metrics.name: process_handles
metrics.semantic_boundary: process/thread/handle/file-descriptor/timer/watcher populations, typed separately
metrics.derivation: Measured finite lifecycle including teardown, membership and co-tenants

metrics.name: control_latency
metrics.semantic_boundary: issue to durable acceptance/refusal; separately observation and settlement
metrics.derivation: Open-loop independent control schedule; p50/p95/p99 with uncertainty

metrics.name: input_latency
metrics.semantic_boundary: input available to backend acceptance and separately rendered feedback
metrics.derivation: Frozen sink/drain/focus profile; p50/p95/p99

metrics.name: append_latency
metrics.semantic_boundary: append request to declared durable acknowledgement; queue/service/flush split
metrics.derivation: Same durability promise and independent ACK witness; p50/p95/p99

metrics.name: task_latency
metrics.semantic_boundary: scheduled arrival to independently verified useful outcome
metrics.derivation: Unique tasks, helpers/retries/review/correction, censored outcomes retained; p50/p95/p99 when estimable

metrics.name: recovery_latency
metrics.semantic_boundary: fault to detection, replay readiness, safe authority and productive continuation
metrics.derivation: Declared fault domain with independent recovery/continuity oracle; p50/p95/p99 when estimable

metrics.name: accepted_throughput
metrics.unit: accepted unique tasks per wall interval
metrics.semantic_boundary: full exposure including review/recovery/drain tails
metrics.derivation: Baseline and treatment same corpus/gates; Owner practical margin before confirmation

metrics.name: queues
metrics.semantic_boundary: per-owner high-water and oldest age; control reserve distinct
metrics.derivation: Calibrated bounded queue plus overload falsifier; all thresholds unknown

metrics.name: presentation_loss
metrics.semantic_boundary: coalesced presentation, replay gap, optional telemetry drop and canonical loss separate
metrics.derivation: Independent canonical witness; canonical loss is categorical failure

metrics.name: disk_growth
metrics.unit: logical and allocated bytes per interval/task
metrics.semantic_boundary: DB/log/WAL/SHM/CAS/checkpoints/backups/quarantine/old+new releases/temp
metrics.derivation: All-byte accounting; worst declared transient plus recovery reserve

metrics.name: io_network
metrics.unit: typed operations and bytes per interval/task
metrics.semantic_boundary: collector scope distinguishes logical I/O, filesystem/device and network attribution
metrics.derivation: Measured native counters; do not infer physical-media writes or egress from missing data

metrics.name: review_debt
metrics.unit: count, age, active minutes and drain duration
metrics.semantic_boundary: open/independently closed obligations and downstream corrections
metrics.derivation: Matched controlled review service trace; real human endpoint requires later observation

metrics.name: config_cost
metrics.semantic_boundary: compile/validate/commit/effective plus target pending age, edit errors and explanation work
metrics.derivation: Same typed edits and whole effective revisions across profiles; Owner thresholds unknown

metrics.name: accounting
metrics.semantic_boundary: provider quantities, subscription-window delta, money, helpers and reservations
metrics.derivation: Exact qualified source only; synthetic fixtures prove ledger rules, not live debit

metrics.name: release_maintenance
metrics.semantic_boundary: total install closure, privileged/total code, upgrade/revalidation and review work
metrics.derivation: Equivalent comprehensive capability contract and declared upgrade scenarios

metrics.name: reserve
metrics.semantic_boundary: non-overlapping integrity/recovery/co-tenant/uncertainty allowances
metrics.derivation: Measured stress/recovery demand and Owner-adopted ceiling; legacy 25% not newly accepted

metrics.name: telemetry_overhead
metrics.semantic_boundary: required-evidence versus local metrics versus rich trace/export delta
metrics.derivation: Calibrate witness perturbation separately; preserve absolute results and uncertainty

profile_labels.coordinator-small: Historical 2-vCPU/4-GB class target, actual measured identity unknown
profile_labels.interactive-workstation: Historical 32-logical-processor/64-GB class observation, current capacity unknown
profile_labels.registered-worker: No fixed hardware assumption; declared job envelope required
